Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: A user comment on a blog post

userPhoto.description: Profile picture URL of the commenter

parentId.description: ID of parent comment if it's a reply

adminHearted.description: Whether an admin hearted this comment

PostLike.title: PostLike
PostLike.description: A user's like on a blog post

userId.description: The UID of the user who liked

postSlug.description: The slug of the bookmarked post

/postComments/{postSlug}/comments/{comme.description: Stores comments for a specific blog post where the document ID is the slug.

/postLikes/{postSlug}/likes/{userId}.description: Stores likes for a specific blog post. Document ID is the user's UID.

/users/{userId}/bookmarks/{postSlug}.description: Stores bookmarked posts for a specific user. Document ID is the post slug.
